Корабль эскорта Федерации.machine: Ship of the Escort of the Federation

Корабль эскорта кристалинов.machine: The ship of the escort of crystalins

Используя последние запасы топлива, вы с.machine: Using the latest fuel reserves, you were able to take the ship to a safe distance from the pulsar.

Вот чёрт! Эта планета в союзе с повстанц.machine: Here is the hell!This planet is in alliance with the rebels, and they are firing us!

С помощью своих импульсных двигателей вы.machine: Using your pulsed engines, you were able to move to a safe distance from the hostile planet.

Ваш пилот ловко уклоняется от артиллерий.machine: Your pilot deftly evades the artillery fire surrounding you with the flotilla, while you are trying to figure out the situation and come up with some plan ...

Поискать, кто готов с вами торговать..machine: Look for who is ready to trade with you.

Вы решаете не испытывать удачу и двигает.machine: You decide not to feel good luck and move on.

(Контроль разума) Изменить мнение говоря.machine: (Control of the mind) change the opinion of the speaker.

Вы находите источник вещания и \"убеждае.machine: You find the source of broadcasting and "convince" him to abandon your words.Let's hope that you have enough time to become stuck until it gets to it what has just happened.

(Улучшенный контроль разума) Изменить мн.machine: (Improved control of the mind) change the speaker's opinion.

Вы находите источник вещания и \"убеждае.machine: You find the source of broadcasting and "convince" him to abandon your words.Moreover, apologizing to you, he offers free goods.Let's hope you have enough time to stagnate until it gets to it what has just happened.

(Продвинутый контроль разума) Изменить м.machine: (Advanced control of the mind) change the speaker's opinion.

Вы находите источник вещания и \"убеждае.machine: You find the source of broadcasting and "convince" him to abandon your words.Moreover, apologizing to you, he offers a lot of free goods.Let's hope that you have enough time to become stuck until it gets to it what has just happened.

На ваши позывные отозвался всего один ма.machine: Only one store responded to your call sign: “No general communication channels.We will sell you what to ask, but we better not attract attention. ”

Ваш запрос на дружественный обмен не даё.machine: Your request for friendly exchange does not give results, but after a while a small shuttle is approaching.They send a few materials in your direction with the message: “Not all here are friends of the rebel fleet.Stay strong. "

В поисках магазина вы явно связались не.machine: In search of the store, you clearly did not contact the one with whom you need.Anxiety signals are turned on, and ship sensors detect a drone of rebels, which is going to intercept.

Капитан повстанцев появляется на экране..machine: The captain of the rebels appears on the screen.“I thought we were doomed to fulfill provincial instructions.This is my chance to return the favor of the command!Charge the guns! "

Вы находите небольшую научную станцию по.machine: You find a small scientific station of the rebels engaged in the study of Pulsar.Before you can react, the ship's ship detects you and begins the attack.

Вы прибываете к редко используемому маяк.machine: You come to a rarely used lighthouse near Pulsar.Soon nearby, a ship of the rebels leaves the jump.It seems to have to fight.

Сенсоры сходят с ума, обнаружив неподалё.machine: Sensors go crazy, discovering the pulsar nearby.While you are trying to calibrate the FTL drive, a pirate ship creeps up to you, charging tools.Get ready for battle!

Прибыв в сектор, вы видите на экране гро.machine: Arriving in the sector, you see a huge pulsar on the screen, and in front of it is a tiny moving silhouette.While you are trying to understand that this is, silence explodes anxiety signals.It looks like this is a ship on the interception trajectory!

Небольшая исследовательская станция нахо.machine: A small research station is located in the orbit of a nearby pulse.Everything indicates that it is abandoned, but as soon as you approach the scanning distance, the devices record signs of energy weapons.A small warship starts from the station.Pirates!

(Взломщик) Сбить прицел противокорабельн.machine: (Cracker) knock the sight of the enemy’s anti -ship battery.

Вы обнаружили уязвимость в системе спутн.machine: You have found vulnerability in the satellite guidance system.Your team is able to launch a drum drone to change the target search matrix.As a result, the enemy’s anti -ship battery will attack you and the rebels.

You have found vulnerability in the satellite guidance system.Your team is able to launch an improved drum drone to rewrite the matrix of searching for the target.As a result, the enemy’s anti -ship battery will attack the ship's ship instead of yours!

Вы потрясены, обнаружив передовую базу п.machine: You are shocked by finding the advanced base of the rebels on this planet.The patrol ship goes for interception, and the sensors show that the anti-ship battery is about to shoot.We must get out of here!

Вы обнаружили уязвимость в системе спутн.machine: You have found vulnerability in the satellite guidance system.Your team is able to launch a drum drone to periodically change the options for capturing the target.As a result, the enemy’s anti -ship battery will sometimes attack the ship of the rebels.

(Продвинутый взломщик) Изменить цель ПКБ.machine: (Advanced cracker) change the purpose of the PKB.

Вы обнаруживаете уязвимость в спутниках.machine: You find vulnerability in guidance satellites.Your team manages to launch an advanced drum drone to rewrite information about the purpose of the PCB.Now she will fire on the ship's ship!

Как только вы появляетесь, раздаются сра.machine: As soon as you appear, several alarm signals are heard at once.You are detected by an enemy automated ship, as well as an anti -ship battery opens fire.This is not good!

Видя, что его звено уничтожено, командир.machine: Seeing that his link was destroyed, the commander of the rebels is trying to escape by holding his tail.

Корабль повстанцев, совершив прыжок, скр.machine: The ship's ship, having made a jump, is hiding from sight.

Когда угроза исчезла, вы связываетесь с.machine: When the threat disappeared, you are associated with the outpost of the federation.They answer: “Our coordinates are known to the rebels!Take everything you can, and please accompany the survivors to the nearest base. ”One of the soldier accepted on board expressed a desire to join your team.The outpost also sends a couple of repair drones to your ship.

Вы разбираете обломки на лом..machine: You disassemble the wreckage on the scrap.

Уничтожив экипаж, вы обшариваете корабль.machine: Having destroyed the crew, you rummage the ship.

Этот сектор по большей части был заброше.machine: This sector for the most part was abandoned since the local population was destroyed in a series of battles.There are reports of a strange race that organized the collection of fragments in this area.You better be on the alert.

В этом секторе состоялись многие крупные.machine: In this sector, many major battles were held between the fleets of the Federation and the rebels.Strange, but there are practically no traces of these battles ...

Не так давно стало известно о мощных кор.machine: Not so long ago it became known about powerful ships that analyze the wreckage and abandoned mining settlements in this sector.Did the Laniuses take their own again?

Война уже разрушила этот гражданский сек.machine: The war has already destroyed this civilian sector, but recently, even the few remaining signs of life began to go out one after another.They say that there were no lanius.

С недавних пор корабли стали обходить эт.machine: Recently, the ships began to bypass this sector.Rumor has it that monsters who did not need oxygen settled here ...

Ланиусы, поселившиеся в этом секторе, уж.machine: Laniuses who settled in this sector have already managed to benefit from the war.Here you can not find the remains of the ships who died in battles, these garbagemen absorbed them.

Ходят слухи, что в этом секторе обитают.machine: There are rumors that monsters living in a vacuum and feed on scrap live in this sector.What these inexperienced travelers will not come up with.

В этом опасном секторе вашей абордажной.machine: In this dangerous sector, your boarding team will have a hard time - after all, there is no oxygen compartment on enemy ships.Damned scammers!

Ланиусы пойдут на что угодно ради лома,.machine: Laniuses will go to anything for the sake of scrap, in this sector you will have to look at your ship properly.Maybe it was worth flying the other way?

Местное население покинуло этот сектор,.machine: The local population has left this sector since Lanius came here.In a short time, they cleaned everything from the metal everything they could reach.It's time to finish with these looters.

В этом секторе когда-то проводилась круп.machine: In this sector, a lot of work was carried out on the construction of warships for the needs of the Federation.It was here that the first attack of the rebels was directed here, causing incorrigible damage to the Federation of the Federation.Eyewitnesses flying here speak of lanius activity, so be careful.

Поверхностное сканирование близлежащих м.machine: Superficial scanning of nearby lighthouses does not detect any signs of life.Moreover, you cannot find a single object containing metal.Something is wrong here ...

Когда-то в этом секторе добывали немало.machine: Once in this sector a lot of minerals were mined.Now, after several major battles of the federation and rebels, there is more likely a cemetery of ships.But something suggests that it is still not safe here ...

Судя по докладам разведчиков, здесь обос.machine: Judging by the reports of the scouts, laniuses settled here.So, you can get hold of a crowbar if you manage to wash it from under the nose of strangers.

По прибытии в этот сектор ваш корабль чу.machine: Upon arrival in this sector, your ship almost pulled out a group of Lanius.I had to prove for a long time that you are not a saying piece of scrap ...

Судя по данным разведчиков, данный секто.machine: Judging by the scout data, this sector is abandoned.But the ships of the Lanius scurrying back and forth talk about the opposite ...

В отдалении видны груды обломков погибши.machine: In the distance, piles of fragments of the dead ships are visible in the distance, something flickers among them ...

Сенсоры засекли слабый сигнал, но вокруг.machine: Sensors spotted a weak signal, but there is nothing around but rare fragments of ships disassembled by someone.It is worth being careful ... If you are not looking for problems, they can find you yourself.

Когда-то здесь кипела жизнь, но после кр.machine: Once life was in full swing here, but after a major battle between the rebels and the federation, this sector came into desolation.Strange, but you don’t notice the traces of that battle anywhere ... the pilot grumbles that the laniuses clearly tried.

Большой транспортный корабль, находящийс.machine: A large transport ship in the repair dock is in contact.“Greetings, friends!We will dump from this sector as soon as we fix this cooling shaft, and I advise you to do the same.I almost feel that these damn metal freaks are about to appear and try to fry our ship.By the way, do not want to buy anything?We throw off the junk. "

По прибытии вы обнаруживаете рядом нечто.machine: Upon arrival, you discover something resembling a space station to which Lanius ships are moored.You are going to take your feet out of here, but you calm down, getting a message in your native language from the station: “Buy?Sell?Trade".Obviously, not only garbagemen, but also merchants live here.

Около этого маяка расположен торговый по.machine: Near this lighthouse is a trade post.The station is protected by an impressive number of warships.On the common channels there is an advertisement: “We have everything for ships: spare parts, service, refueling, souvenirs.Take a look at the assortment of the only store on this side of Omikron-6, which is not afraid of looters. ”

Вы прибываете на пустую космическую стан.machine: You arrive at the empty space station, clearly abandoned due to the threat of Lanius attack.Scanners record living organisms in the warehouse compartment, and you notice a few heated inscriptions: “Full sale!”

Этот маяк кипит жизнью. Похоже, некоторы.machine: This lighthouse boils with life.It seems that some merchants decided to earn on the fact that dozens of refugee ships use this place to recharge their FTL drives.You are viewing their goods.

Вы получаете сообщение от соседней станц.machine: You get a message from the neighboring station: “This is the end for us!Metal demons came to absorb our essence!But it’s not too late to prepare for the worst! ”It seems that this is an advertisement for space dock.You are viewing their goods.

Графики показывают, что здесь была небол.machine: The graphs show that there was a small fight for a military facility on the next moon.Oddly enough, the scanners did not find any signs of debris either at the battlefield or at the station itself.Another area is completely cleaned with lanius.

Никаких признаков кораблей или поселений.machine: Sensors do not register any signs of ships or settlements.It is not clear whether there was always no one here, or did Lanius worked here.

Немногочисленные корабли беженцев готовя.machine: A few refugees ships are preparing for a long trip to another sector.They explain that several Lanius warships surrounded them and began to hack their FTL drives.Fortunately, the Laniuses left after a brief scanning of civilian ships, leaving them in great confusion.

Среди черноты космоса вы обнаруживаете с.machine: Among the blackness of the cosmos, you find the Lanius station.These scums, as always, are busy with the absorption of metal scrap and do not pay attention to your ship.However, your attention is drawn to the unusual tools installed at the station, in no sector you have not seen this.If you can get them, it will help your mission.

Атаковать станцию, пока они заняты погло.machine: Attack the station while they are busy with the absorption of scrap.

Вы запрашиваете связь со станцией, но в.machine: You request a connection with the station, but in response you only hear the rattle of the metal.After that, the guns at the station are activated and aimed at your ship!There is no choice, you have to accept the battle.

Вы решаете не рисковать и заряжаете двиг.machine: You decide not to take risks and load the engines for the jump until the laniuses set about your ship.

(Член экипажа ланиус) Отправить ланиуса.machine: (Crew member Lanius) Send Lanius to negotiations.

Вы решаете нанести первый удар, пока лан.machine: You decide to deliver the first blow until the laniuses at the station have noticed you.However, the security system was activated at the station, which makes a volley on your ship!You do not have time to react, and the ship receives damage.
You decide to deliver the first blow until the laniuses at the station have noticed you.The first salvo of your guns disables the weapon system at the station, now it will work at half the capacity.

Они готовятся к ответной атаке..machine: They are preparing for a return attack.

Ланиус с вашего корабля связывается со с.machine: Lanius from your ship is associated with its relatives at the station.He explains that you are interested in their weapons and want to purchase it.Laniuses for everything are ready for the sake of metal, they agree to give you one gun for 90 scraps.

Вы передаёте лом, и они устанавливают ор.machine: You convey scrap and install the gun on your ship.

Вы решаете, что это слишком большая цена.machine: You decide that this is too much price, and it’s easier to pick up the gun for free.Laniuses are preparing for defense.

Ланиусы соглашаются, что их цена неоправ.machine: Laniuses agree that their price is unjustified, and voiced a new price - 60 scrap.

Вы решаете, что проще забрать орудие бес.machine: You decide that it’s easier to pick up the gun for free.Laniuses are preparing for defense.

Ланиусы соглашаются, что их цена неоправ.machine: Laniuses agree that their price is unjustified, and voiced a new price - 40 scraps.

После взрыва вы подбираете один из прото.machine: After the explosion, you select one of the prototypes of the gun installed at the station.Unfortunately, the second was destroyed during the battle.

Уничтожив вражескую команду, вы подбирае.machine: Having destroyed the enemy team, you select one of the prototypes of the gun installed at the station.Unfortunately, the second was badly damaged during the battle.

Собрать со станции лом и улететь..machine: Collect scrap from the station and fly away.

Вы собираете лом, оставшийся на станции,.machine: You collect scrap lefting at the station and make a jump.

(Член экипажа инжи) Дать взглянуть вашем.machine: (Member of the Ingo crew) Let your engineering look at the breakdown.

Инжи смог устранить неисправность во вто.machine: Inji was able to eliminate the malfunction in the second gun.Having collected fragments flying nearby, you give an order to jump.

(Член экипажа морф) Дать взглянуть вашем.machine: (Member of the crew of the morph) let your morfus look at the breakdown.

Морф смог устранить неисправность во вто.machine: The morph was able to eliminate the malfunction in the second gun.Having collected fragments flying nearby, you give an order to jump.

Как только вы появляетесь у маяка, к вам.machine: As soon as you appear at the lighthouse, an elite drone flies to you overpatse!Return late, get ready for battle.

Беспилотник уничтожен, среди его обломко.machine: The drone is destroyed, among its wreckage you find one surviving tool.

На этом маяке обосновался торговец-скупщ.machine: A wiper has settled on this lighthouse, who is ready to buy supplies from you at basic prices.Well, or just sell something.

Продать лишние припасы и посмотреть това.machine: Sell ​​extra supplies and see the goods.

Вы проверяете количество припасов на кор.machine: You check the number of supplies on the ship.

Вы не хотите продавать свои припасы и пр.machine: You do not want to sell your supplies and just look at the goods.

Вы заканчиваете обмен и смотрите, что ск.machine: You finish the exchange and see that the buyer can offer for sale.

Прямо перед вами среди туманности медлен.machine: Right in front of you among the nebula, the Avatar station is slowly drifting.An unidentified type tools are installed at the station, but so far everything looks quiet.It is useless to contact the avatars, they are not able to communicate in language accessible to living beings.

Станция немедленно активируется в ответ.machine: The station is immediately activated in response to your aggression.

Не рискнув связываться с аватарами, вы о.machine: Without daring to contact the avatars, you give an order to jump.

(Член экипажа аватар) Позволить вашему а.machine: (Avatar crew member) let your avatar arrange a sabotage at the station.

Аватар, пользуясь тем, что его принимают.machine: The avatar, taking advantage of the fact that he is mistaken for his own, makes his way into the compartment of the drones.He managed to half out of order before other avatars intervened and sprayed him into molecules.The station is preparing for the battle.

Аватар выходит из кабинки клонирования и.machine: The avatar leaves the cloning cabin and goes to its place.

Взрыв разметает обломки станции во все с.machine: The explosion spreads the fragments of the station in all directions.Nevertheless, one of the prototypes flies past your ship, it seems that it is still working.

Все аватары уничтожены. Один из прототип.machine: All avatars are destroyed.One of the prototypes looks intact, but the second is very hooked, it is unlikely that it can be repaired.

Перед вами останки бомбардировщика Федер.machine: Here are the remains of the bomber of the federation.The sheathing of its body is covered with traces of blood.You send communication requests, but no one answers.

Вскрыть шлюзы корабля и осмотреть содерж.machine: Open the gateways of the ship and inspect the contents.

Внутри вы находите следы кровавой бойни.machine: Inside you find traces of a bloody massacre and many dead people.

Собрать всё, что плохо лежит, и поскорее.machine: Collect everything that lies badly and leave as soon as possible.

(Феромоны мантисов) Собрать как можно бо.machine: (Mantis pheromones) Gather as many supplies as possible under the influence of pheromones and leave as soon as possible.

Команда быстро переносит в ваш трюм всё.machine: The team quickly carries everything useful to your hold.Now you need to fly away.

Сделать залп по останкам корабля..machine: Make a salvo on the remains of the ship.

Выглядит подозрительно. Лучше улететь от.machine: It looks suspicious.It is better to fly away from here.

(Член экипажа слаг) Пусть слаг проверит.machine: (Member of the crew of Slavs) Let the Slag check the presence of life on the ship.

Здесь нельзя задерживаться. Ваша команда.machine: You can’t linger here.Your team understands this.

10.text: While searching the ship, your crew is attacked by a strange black creature with acid for blood. You manage to gather some useful items, but the xenomorph pursues your team and gets aboard your ship with them!

12.text: During the ship inspection, your crew is attacked by a strange black creature with acid instead of blood. You manage to gather some useful things, but the xenomorph chases the crew and sneaks onto your ship with them!

Вокруг остались лишь тела погибших....machine: Only the bodies of the dead remained around ...

Им уже ничем не помочь, время улетать..machine: They no longer help them, time to fly away.

Перед отлётом вы решаете, стоит ли уничт.machine: Before the departure, you decide whether it is worth destroying the remains of the bombarder.

(Клон-отсек) Принести немного биологичес.machine: (Clone-hats) bring a little biological material to the clone camera.

(Улучшенный клон-отсек) Принести немного.machine: (Improved clone-hats) to bring a little biological material to the clone camera.

(Продвинутый клон-отсек) Принести немног.machine: (Advanced clone-hats) to bring a little biological material to the clone camera.

Из останков одного мертвеца удаётся клон.machine: From the remains of one dead man manages to clone a new member of the team.He says that their ship had terrible creatures with a double row of teeth and acidic blood.The whole team has died, and creatures are probably still on the ship.Before the departure, you decide whether it is worth destroying the remains of the bombarder.

From the remains of one dead man manages to clone a new member of the team.You ask what happened on their ship, but he does not remember anything.Before the departure, you decide whether it is worth destroying the remains of the bombarder.

Клон-отсек воскрешает его, и он испуганн.machine: The clone-hats resurrects him, and he frightenedly asks you to fly away from here rather.

На корабле не обнаружено признаков жизни.machine: There were no signs of life on the ship.You calmly collect everything valuable.

Вам удаётся найти немного припасов, раск.machine: You manage to find a little supplies scattered along the compartments of the ship.You do not risk lingering here longer than necessary.

С помощью хирургических инструментов ваш.machine: With the help of surgical instruments of your honey, it is possible to cut out an alien parasite from the infected chest.Unfortunately, this happened too late, and the patient dies on the operating table.Sadly, but you need to move on.Before the departure, you decide whether it is worth destroying the remains of the bombarder.

Вам удаётся вырезать паразита из его гру.machine: You manage to cut a parasite from his chest, and a person joins the team.

Спросить его, что произошло на корабле..machine: Ask him what happened on the ship.

В благодарность он рассказывает вам о се.machine: In gratitude, he tells you about the secret mission of the Federation to seize and transport biological weapons from a remote planet.This "weapon" fled and killed the whole team on their ship.He invites you to capture one of the strangers to complete his mission.

Мы не будем в это ввязываться, космос и.machine: We will not get involved in this, space is too dangerous.

Спросить его, не осталось ли на корабле.machine: Ask him if there is something useful on the ship.

В благодарность он рассказывает о резерв.machine: In gratitude, he talks about backup fuel in a secret storage.Before the departure, you decide whether it is worth destroying the remains of the bombarder.

В системе вентиляции вы находите еле жив.machine: In the ventilation system, you find a barely living coughing person.He hardly says that someone is alive in his chest ...

Жуть какая, собрать валяющиеся рядом при.machine: What a horror, to collect supplies lying nearby and throw it to die.

#RECORD-155. The Great Zoltan Wartime Code.
#155.1.1. The highest authority is the Supreme Commander of the Zoltan fleet.
#155.1.2. The orders of the Supreme Commander of the Zoltan fleet are to be executed immediately, and their statements are to be taken as absolute truth.
#155.1.3. Any living organism that opposes the will of the Supreme Commander is subject to forced submission.
#155.1.3a. If submission cannot be achieved, the organism is subject to liquidation.
#155.2.1. Slavery is prohibited in Zoltan sectors (the trade of sentient living beings against their will).
#155.2.1a. The prohibition of slavery is lifted in a critical state of war.
#155.3.1. Any colonization of planets, other than that carried out by the Zoltan, is prohibited.
#155.4.1. Any terraforming operations are prohibited until consent for terraforming is obtained from all inhabitants of the planet.
#155.4.2. If less than 1% of the planet's population disagrees with terraforming, forced relocation is permitted.
#155.5.1. Upon the declaration of a state of war, every Zoltan ship possessing weaponry must report to the Zoltan fleet for further instructions.
#155.6.1. The decision to declare a state of war (critical or ordinary) is made by the Zoltan council.
#155.6.2. The number of council members shall be no less than 200. The required level of decision unity is 100%.
#155.7.1. Every Zoltan citizen has the right to self-determination, productive labor, support, and respect from Zoltan society.
#155.8.1. Every Zoltan citizen is obligated to comply with all rules of all existing codes and regulations.
#155.9.1. No being belonging to another race may become a citizen of Zoltan society.
#155.9.1a. The Supreme Commander of the Zoltan fleet may grant the status of "citizen" to a being of another race.
#155.10.1. A citizen of Zoltan society may freely leave and return to the territory of civilian sectors, provided they report on the path taken and the events that occurred.
#155.11.1. The extraction of materials and any raw resources in Zoltan sectors is permitted only with a license.
#155.11.2. Any materials obtained in a Zoltan sector without the appropriate license are subject to confiscation, with a fine equal to double the value of the materials.
#155.12.1. Listening to and storing "The Great Zoltan Wartime Code" is permitted only in the presence of a Zoltan representative.
#155.12.2. Copying or any distortion of the information specified in this code is prohibited.
#155.13.1. In the event of an encounter with a hostile invader, any Zoltan ship is obligated to carry out the standard cleanup procedure.
#155.13.2. Equipment obtained as a result of the cleanup procedure must be delivered to the head of the Zoltan fleet.
#155.13.3. If cleanup is not possible, a tactical retreat is permitted, followed by the transmission of information to the head of the Zoltan fleet.
#155.14.1. Any transit transport operations through a Zoltan sector are subject to inspection.
#155.14.2. If a ship refuses inspection, it is considered a hostile invader.
#155.14.3. As a result of a ship inspection, any equipment included in the list of prohibited technologies may be confiscated.
#155.14.4. The Zoltan patrol is not obligated to explain the motivation for its actions to anyone (except the Zoltan leadership).
#155.15.1. Any trade actions that lead to the deterioration of the Zoltan race's economy are prohibited.
#155.15.2. The transportation of any alien equipment into Zoltan sectors without passing through customs is prohibited.
#155.15.3. When moving through a Zoltan sector, a Zoltan representative must be on board transit ships.
#155.15.4. In the absence of a Zoltan representative, movement must be carried out at minimum engine thrust, with weapons and shields disabled.
#155.15.5. If the trajectories of ships intersect, the Zoltan ship has the right of way (in disputed cases, the ship with the greater mass).
#155.16.1. Every living organism has the right to life.
#155.16.1a. Any living organism newly discovered by the Zoltan race must be placed in cryostasis in the general library for species preservation.
#155.16.2. A living organism that violates (or attempts to violate) the right to life of another living organism forfeits its own right to life.
#155.16.2a. The destruction of another living organism in the course of fulfilling the conditions of this code does not deprive the executor of their right to life.
#155.16.3. Any sentient living organism has the right to be heard by the head of the Zoltan fleet.
#155.16.4. Conducting experiments on sentient living organisms is prohibited within Zoltan sectors.
#155.16.5. If a sentient living organism violates the articles of this code, it is reclassified as a NON-sentient living organism.
#155.16.6. Non-sentient living organisms are subject to registration with the mandatory assignment of an owner (responsible for their behavior) and have only the right to life.
#155.16.7. In the case of aggression by a living organism that threatens the lives of other organisms, its liquidation is permitted.
#155.16.7a. A living organism under mind control is not considered responsible for any of its actions.
#155.16.8. The murder/abduction of any member of the Zoltan race is punishable by death.
#155.17.1. Any ship in a Zoltan sector that has violated the rules of this code must proceed to the sector leadership to decide its fate.
#155.17.2. When crossing the border of a Zoltan sector, every ship must undergo identification and receive permission for transit.
#155.17.3. Any ship in a Zoltan sector without official permission is considered a hostile invader.
#155.17.4. Analysis and disassembly of any Zoltan equipment is prohibited. If you need to obtain a map of the current sector, press the white button on this device.
#155.17.5. Scanning of any Zoltan stars, planets, asteroids, ships, stations, projectiles, and wreckage without official permission is prohibited.
#155.17.6. Any ship bearing pirate insignia is considered a hostile invader.
#155.17.7. If the crew of a pirate ship proves their loyalty to the Zoltan, they will be given assistance.
#155.17.8. If the military situation becomes critical, the Zoltan fleet is obligated to support any ships acting in their military interests (regardless of the equipment carried by the ship).
#155.17.8a. Corrective list of technologies permitted in Zoltan sectors (with all accompanying documents): ion weaponry (all classes), beam weaponry (all classes), bomb weaponry (all classes), missile weaponry (power consumption no more than 3 units), Zoltan shield, any Zoltan shield generators, laser weaponry (small and medium caliber only).
#155.17.8b. Minimum assistance from the Zoltan fleet is equal to 5 fuel cells.
#155.17.8c. Attempting to doubt the competence of the Zoltan leadership is equated to deep disrespect and insult. Such behavior towards the Zoltan race is subject to eradication throughout the Galaxy.
#155.17.8d. If none of a ship's jumps within a Zoltan sector have been coordinated with the Zoltan race, the ship is considered a hostile invader.
#END OF RECORD-155.

#RECORD-155. The Great Zoltan Wartime Code.
#155.1.1. The Supreme Commander of the Zoltan Fleet is the supreme authority.
#155.1.2. Orders of the Supreme Commander are to be carried out immediately, and their statements are accepted as absolute truth.

#155.4.1. Any terraforming operations are forbidden without consent from all residents of the planet.
#155.4.2. In case of disagreement by less than 1% of the population, forced relocation is permitted.

#155.6.1. The decision to declare martial law (critical or standard) is made by the Zoltan council.

#155.7.1. Every Zoltan citizen has the right to self-determination, productive labor, support, and respect from Zoltan society.
#155.8.1. Every Zoltan citizen must comply with all codes and regulations.
#155.9.1. No being of another race may become a citizen of Zoltan society.

#155.11.2. Any materials obtained in Zoltan sectors without a license are subject to seizure with a fine of double the value of the materials.

#155.12.2. Copying or distorting information in this code is forbidden.

#155.13.3. If clearing is impossible, a tactical retreat is permitted, followed by reporting to the Head of the Zoltan Fleet.

#155.14.2. Refusal of inspection equates the ship to a hostile invader.
#155.14.3. During inspection, any equipment on the prohibited technology list may be confiscated.
#155.14.4. A Zoltan patrol is not required to explain its motivations to anyone other than Zoltan leadership.

#155.15.2. Transporting alien equipment into Zoltan sectors without clearing customs is forbidden.

#155.16.8. Murder or abduction of any Zoltan is punishable by death.

10.text: The goal is to beat the dealer by scoring more points than them. Number cards are worth their face value, J-Q-K are worth 10, and A is worth 1 or 11. You cannot score more than 21 - that's a bust. The player and dealer are dealt 2 cards face up. If the player gets 21 on the first two cards ("blackjack") and the dealer has less, the player wins 1.5 times their bet. If the dealer has blackjack and the player doesn't, the player loses. If neither has blackjack, the player can draw one card at a time until they bust (which is a loss, and the bet goes to the dealer) or decide to stand. Then, the dealer draws cards until they have at least 17 (even if they already have more than the player), or until they bust. The scores are compared, and the bets go to whoever has more. In all cases of a tie, bets are returned.

12.text: The goal of the game is to beat the dealer by having more points than them. Number cards are worth their face value, J-Q-K are 10 points, and A is 1 or 11. You cannot exceed 21 points—that is a bust. Both the player and dealer are dealt 2 cards face up. If the player gets 21 points in the first two cards ("blackjack") and the dealer has less, the player gets a 1.5x payout. If the dealer has blackjack and the player doesn't, the player loses. If no one has blackjack, the player can hit until they bust (loss, bet goes to dealer) or decide to stop. Then the dealer draws cards to at least 17 points (even if they already have more than the player) until they bust or reach 17. Points are compared, and the bet goes to the one with the highest total. In all tie cases, the bet is returned.

10.text:
The goal is to beat the dealer by having a better hand. There are 10 hands in increasing order of strength:
1. High Card (strongest card in hand - A)
2. Pair (2 cards of the same rank - 88)
3. Two Pair (2 cards of one rank and 2 of another - QQ55)
4. Three of a Kind (3 cards of the same rank - KKK)
5. Straight (5 sequential cards - 10JQKA)
6. Flush (5 cards of the same suit)
7. Full House (3 cards of one rank and 2 of another - JJ777)
8. Four of a Kind (4 cards of the same rank - JJJJ)
9. Straight Flush (5 sequential cards of the same suit - 56789)
10. Royal Flush (5 sequential cards 10JQKA of the same suit)
An Ace can count as 1 for straights (A2345, but not QKA23). At the start, the dealer gets 2 cards, the player gets 2, and 5 community cards are placed on the table (3 of which are revealed immediately). The player can check, raise, or fold. The dealer calls, raises, or folds, and the next community card is revealed. If the player didn't raise, the dealer can, and then to continue, the player must also raise. This cycle repeats until all cards are revealed. In case of a tie in hands, the highest cards in those hands are compared. If all cards in the hands are equal, the highest cards not part of the hand (kickers) are compared. If those are also equal, the next highest kickers are compared. The winner takes the pot. In a tie, the pot is split.

12.text:
The goal of the game is to beat the dealer by having a better hand combination. There are 10 combinations in increasing order of strength:
1. High Card (strongest card in hand - A)
2. Pair (2 cards of same rank - 88)
3. Two Pair (2 cards of same rank, 2 of another - QQ55)
4. Three of a Kind (3 cards of same rank - KKK)
5. Straight (5 consecutive cards - 10JQKA)
6. Flush (5 cards of the same suit)
7. Full House (3 cards of same rank, 2 of another - JJ777)
8. Four of a Kind (4 cards of same rank - JJJJ)
9. Straight Flush (5 consecutive cards of the same suit - 56789)
10. Royal Flush (5 consecutive cards 10JQKA of the same suit)
An Ace can act as a 1 for straights (A2345, but not QKA23). At the start, 2 cards are dealt to the dealer, 2 to the player, and 5 shared (3 face up). The player can call, raise, or fold. The dealer responds, raises, or folds, and the next card is revealed. If the player didn't raise, the dealer can, requiring the player to call to continue. The cycle repeats until all cards are revealed. If combinations are tied, the high cards in them are compared. If they are equal, kickers are compared. Winner takes the pot. In case of a tie, the pot is split.

Игнорировать сообщение и поговорить с эк.machine: To ignore the message and talk to the crew while the FTL engine is charged.

По мере приближения к координатам корпус.machine: As it approaches the coordinates, the case begins to heat up monstrously, but you manage to find a small ship of morphs.Apparently, they are stuck here without fuel.What are we going to do?

Морфы спешно заправляются и готовятся ул.machine: Morphs hastily refuel and are preparing to fly away ...

... перед самым отлётом они благодарят в.machine: ... Before the departure, they thank you with useful materials.

Зарядить двигатель и улететь..machine: Charge the engine and fly away.

Морфы появляются в вашем коммуникаторе:.machine: Morphs appear in your communicator: “Greeting.Purpose: fragments of the ship’s hull ... Error ... Restart ... Condition: Payment with crowbar. ”

Вы выдираете часть обшивки, а морфы заби.machine: You tear out part of the skin, and morphs take them to yourself, paying for scrap.

Отказаться от предложения, зарядить двиг.machine: Refuse the sentence, charge the engine and fly away.

Морфы снова выходят на связь и просят ещ.machine: Morphs again get in touch and ask for several more pieces of the hull per scrap.

Разобрать ещё 5 единиц корпуса..machine: Disassemble another 5 units of the case.

Вы выдираете куски обшивки, а морфы отда.machine: You tear off pieces of casing, and morphs give the promised scrap.

Разобрать ещё 10 единиц корпуса..machine: Disassemble another 10 units of the case.

Разобрать ещё 15 единиц корпуса..machine: Parse another 15 units of the case.

Отказаться, зарядить двигатель и улететь.machine: Refuse, charge the engine and fly away.

Морфы, похоже, решают взять своё силой и.machine: Morphs seem to decide to take their strength and charge the guns!

Морфы снова выходят на связь и просят ещ.machine: Morphs again get in touch and ask a few more pieces of corps in exchange for some goods.

Вы выдираете куски обшивки, а морфы отда.machine: You tear off pieces of casing, and morphs give the promised equipment.

12.text: A Morph ship at the local beacon sends you a message: "Greeting. Goal: scan sector. Condition: transport Morph analyzer. Agree= Y/N?"

Корабль морфов на местном маяке присылае.machine: The ship of morphs on the local lighthouse sends you a message: “Greetings.Purpose: Sector scanning.Condition: Transportation of an analyzer of morphs.Consent = y/n? "

Морфы дают вам координаты места доставки.machine: Morphs give you the coordinates of the delivery site and their analyzer.

Ожидавшие вас здесь морфы приближаются...machine: Morplers who are waiting for you here are approaching ...

(Анализатор морфов) Предоставить им анал.machine: (Morphs analyzer) provide them with the analyzer.

...Они забирают анализатор и считывают с.machine: ... They take the analyzer and read the data from it, and you receive payment for the work done.

...Они почему-то начинают зарядку своих.machine: ... For some reason they begin to charge their guns!It seems that something went wrong!

Рядом с маяком вы встречаете корабль сла.machine: Next to the lighthouse you meet the ship from the Slagov.They offer you to hunt morphs to get their unique tools.For your help, they offer scrap.

(Анализатор морфов) Показать слагам анал.machine: (Morphs analyzer) Show the lobby the analyzer.

...слаги очень оживляются, увидев ваше у.machine: ... Slaves are very reviving when you see your device.They forget about their first sentence and now offer you to sell them an analyzer.

...Они забирают анализатор и отдают лом..machine: ... They take the analyzer and give the scrap.

...«Вы поплатитесссь за сссвою жадноссст.machine: ... "You are paying for sassy greed!"Slaves charge the guns!

Слаги дают вам лом и координаты корабля-.machine: Slaves give you scrap and coordinates of a target ship.

Отправившись поговорить с экипажем, вы з.machine: Going to talk to the crew, you notice a rattle somewhere under the ship.It turns out that the Slaves decided to quietly merge your fuel!Realizing that they were opened, they charge the guns!

Вы засекаете зарядку FTL-привода..machine: You are cutting a ftl drive.

Рядом с маяком вы встречаете корабль мор.machine: Near the lighthouse you meet a ship of morphs.They immediately attack you.

Цель разваливается на части, и вы собира.machine: The goal is falling apart, and you collect fragments ...

Цель захвачена, и вы забираете всё ценно.machine: The goal is captured, and you take everything valuable ...

Уцелевших орудий морфов не осталось. Сла.machine: There were no surviving instruments of morphs.Slages tell you the coordinates of the next goal.

Вы замечаете, что слаги снимают 2 орудия.machine: You notice that the lads take off 2 instruments of morphs and already want to fly away, but you stop them.They say they were just about to share.What gun will you choose?

Вы грузите орудие и готовитесь к прыжку..machine: You load the gun and prepare for a jump.

10.text: A ship that looks like a regular Engi vessel hails. 'Greeting. Objective: hull fragments from other races' ships. Condition: scrap and a drone schematic. Consent = Y/N?'.

12.text: A ship that looks like a normal Engi vessel contacts you: "Greeting. Goal: hull pieces of other races' ships. Condition: scrap and drone schematic. Agree= Y/N?"

Корабль, выглядящий как обычное судно ин.machine: The ship, looking like an ordinary engine, is in touch."Greetings.Purpose: Pieces of the hull of ships of other races.Condition: scrap and drone scheme.Consent = Y/N? ".

Направить им \"Y\" и получить предоплату.machine: Send them "y" and get an advance payment.

Вам дают координаты корабля-цели..machine: You are given the coordinates of the target ship.

Вы находите корабль-цель и без лишних ра.machine: You find a target ship and, without unnecessary conversations, rush to the attack.

Корабль уничтожен, и вы забираете уцелев.machine: The ship is destroyed, and you take the surviving materials.Soon, the ship that directed you arrives here, and scoures at the scattered pieces of the ship.

Экипаж корабля уничтожен, и вы обчищаете.machine: The crew of the ship is destroyed, and you are cleaning its holds.Soon, the ship that directed you arrives here, and examines the remains of the ship.

Рядом с маяком в супер-шторме на вас нео.machine: Near the lighthouse in the Super Storm, the ship of morphs suddenly attacks you!

Из-за облака туманности на вас нападает.machine: Due to the cloud of nebula, a ship of morphs attacks you!By the way, this storm is much stronger than you met before ...

Ионный шторм у этого маяка глушит ваш ре.machine: The ion storm at this lighthouse is jamming your reactor stronger than usual ... But the troubles are just beginning - the suddenly appearing morphs attack you!

Вы попадаете в супер-шторм, и реактор ко.machine: You get into a super-storm, and the ship’s reactor is almost turned off.In addition, morphs attack you, what a bad day!

Вы залетаете в туманность, вокруг которо.machine: You fly into the nebula, around which a super-scrap is raging.Nearby, a ship of morphs conducts some research.

Из-за облака туманности на вас выскакива.machine: Due to the cloud of the nebula, a ship of morphs jumps out at you!Apologizing, they fly away a little from you.In this super-scrap, nothing is visible ...

Вы попадаете в зону супер-шторма, и реак.machine: You get into the super-scrap zone, and the ship’s reactor is rapidly fading away.Morphs nearby are not in the best position ...

Этот ионный шторм гораздо сильнее обычно.machine: This ion storm is much stronger than usual.The ship of morphs seems to be stuck here for this reason ...

Когда вас останавливали погодные условия.machine: When did you stop weather conditions?

Сегодня не их счастливый день..machine: Today is not their happy day.

Вы не готовы сражаться в таких условиях..machine: You are not ready to fight in such conditions.Maybe another time.

Вблизи маяка небольшая станция морфов. «.machine: Near the lighthouse, a small morph station."Greetings.Title: "Injector Laboratory of Morphs".Purpose: scrap.Services: sales of injectors, fast installation of your injectors in the guns. ”

Игнорировать их и поговорить с экипажем.machine: Ignore them and talk with the crew before charging the FTL engine.

Вы передаёте им лом и получаете инжектор.machine: You give them scrap and get an injector.

Попросить морфов применить ваш инжектор.machine: Ask the morphs to apply your injector to the gun.

Попрощаться и приготовиться к прыжку..machine: Say goodbye and prepare for a jump.

Сразу после выхода из прыжка вам на хвос.machine: Immediately after leaving the jump, a ship of morphs sits on your tail.Their aggressive intentions are not in doubt.

Вы замечаете, что на ваш корабль телепор.machine: You notice that mantes are teleported to your ship!Do morons control them?

О системе, в которой расположен маяк, по.machine: About the system in which the lighthouse is located, terrifying rumors crawl.Morphs here completely lost a sense of compassion and conduct a monstrous experiment: they try to combine several life forms into one.You can sacrifice one of the crew members: morphs always need experimental with unique DNA.

Отправить морфам одного из членов экипаж.machine: Send the morphs one of the crew members.

Человек долго сопротивляется: ссылается.machine: A person resists for a long time: refers to heart disease and a sore liver.In the end, he goes to morphs.In return, you get only a little fuel and scrap: people are widespread, and the morphs always have enough such experimental ones.

(Человек Ордена) Пожертвовать члена экип.machine: (Man of the Order) to donate a crew member.

Так как у морфов хватает инжи для экспер.machine: Since morphs have enough engineering for experiments, they offer your former teammate the work of the cleaner.As compensation, morphs provide you with a little scrap and drones: better than nothing!

Так как у морфов нет недостатка в своих.machine: Since morphs do not have a shortage of their own DNA, they offer your former teammate the work of the cleaner.As compensation, morphs provide you with a little scrap and drones: better than nothing!

Несмотря на то, что мантисы широко распр.machine: Despite the fact that mantes are widespread, it is extremely difficult to catch them for experiments.You do not tell your crew member where exactly he goes, and soon you get a reward - a large bunch of scrap from morphs.

Роков тяжело найти и захватить в плен дл.machine: It is difficult to find and capture the fats for experiments, but they are very tenacious, and each rock is enough for several tests.Morphs compensate for your loss by resources.

Морфы рады провести несколько опытов с о.machine: Morphs are happy to conduct several experiments with fire over the magic.Being impressed by the results, they give you supplies.

10.text: The Morphs are very interested in unraveling the unusual abilities of the Keepers. They are happy to pay for this opportunity.

12.text: Morphs are very interested in unraveling the unusual abilities of the Guardians. They are happy to pay for this opportunity.

Морфы очень заинтересованы в разгадке не.machine: Morphs are very interested in unraveling the unusual abilities of the keepers.They pay with pleasure for this opportunity.

(Молодой машрум) Пожертвовать члена экип.machine: (Young Mashrum) to sacrifice a crew member.

Морфы впервые видят гриб таких размеров..machine: Morphs for the first time see a mushroom of such sizes.They have enough tools for preparation, and you are left useful materials.

(Зрелый машрум) Пожертвовать члена экипа.machine: (Mature Mashrum) to sacrifice a crew member.

(Старый машрум) Пожертвовать члена экипа.machine: (Old Mashrum) to sacrifice a crew member.

Морфы рады провести несколько опытов с о.machine: Morphs are happy to conduct several experiments with fire over the orchid.Being impressed by the results, they give you supplies.

Морфы рады провести несколько опытов с у.machine: Morphs are happy to conduct several experiments with strangulation over an armadillo.Being impressed by the results, they give you supplies.

(Слаг в панцире) Пожертвовать члена экип.machine: (Slavs in the shell) to sacrifice a crew member.

Морфы рады препарировать слага и отделит.machine: Morphs are happy to dissect the lines and separate it from the shell.Being impressed by the results, they give you supplies.

Морфов давно интересуют способности золт.machine: Morphs have long been interested in the abilities of the Zoltans to generate energy and self -destruction.Morphs do not say what they plan to do with your crew member, but they offer to improve the reactor as compensation and a little scrap.

Morphs have long been interested in the abilities of the Zoltons to generate energy.Morphs do not say what they plan to do with your crew member, but they offer to improve the reactor as compensation and a little scrap.

Врождённый инстинкт выживания затрудняет.machine: The congenital survival instinct makes it difficult to use with experiments, making them one of the most desirable experimental for morphs.Having caught your lump, prudently hidden inside the ship’s skin, morphs leave you one of their guns.

Морфы рады изучить зависимость слёрмов о.machine: Morphs are happy to study the dependence of the tears on their favorite drink.It seems that this slaughter is waiting for a hard diet, but this is not your problem ... You take your award and prepare for a jump.

Морфы сразу заинтересовываются вашим лан.machine: Morphs are immediately interested in your lanius, and begin to invent various combinations with other life forms that can facilitate survival in airless conditions.In exchange for Lanius, morphs offer you supplies.

Морфы уже встречали кристаллическую форм.machine: Morphs have already met a crystalline form of life a few months ago, and since then they wanted to find other individuals.They are very grateful to you and offer everything that they have as a reward.

Они с недоумением смотрят на модуль пере.machine: They look at the module of the movement of your avatar in bewilderment.Obviously, it is not suitable for experiments due to the lack of any DNA.

(Резервный банк ДНК) Дать им образцы ДНК.machine: (Reserve Bank of DNA) Give them DNA samples from your backup bank.

Они с благодарностью принимают ваши обра.machine: They gratefully accept your samples and send some supplies in response.

Сканирование не показывает никаких биоло.machine: Scanning does not show any biological remains on the ship, it was unmanned ... very strange.

В обломках вы находите множество человеч.machine: In the wreckage you find many human remains.And you also came across an encrypted system of communication of the rebels.So it became one enemy ship less.

К маяку прибывает корабль повстанцев: «А.machine: A ship of the rebels arrives at the lighthouse: “Aaa!It seems that you have done our dirty work for us.Destroyed refugees from the engineering.Let me give you back reserves in gratitude.We pursued these dogs of the Federation as many as 2 sectors. ”Fortunately, they are too grateful for help to pay attention to who you are.

Кто знает, какие опасности могут содержа.machine: Who knows what dangers can contain fragments?You still do not need stocks.Continue your way.

Вы наткнулись на остатки недавней битвы..machine: You stumbled upon the remnants of a recent battle.One vessel nearby looks as if there can still be valuable resources in it.

Массивная полуразрушенная космическая ст.machine: The massive dilapidated space station is located in orbit near the moon.The initial scan shows that it is empty and abandoned.

Взорвавшиеся обломки на вашем корабле ск.machine: The exploding fragments on your ship most likely contained a disguised explosive device.You do not know why someone set up this ...

Вы даёте им столько лома, сколько можете.machine: You give them as much scrap as you can afford to help with their repair work.

Они благодарят вас, не переставая, и жел.machine: They thank you without ceasing, and wish you good luck in your mission.

(Член экипажа инжи) %req хочет войти на.machine: (Ingozhi crew member) %REQ wants to enter the ship and see if he can personally provide any help.To assist, he asks a certain amount of scrap.

Он вернулся с хорошей новостью. Ему удал.machine: He returned with good news.He managed to improve the engines and convince one of their crew to join you.

12.text: TIP: Accuracy Injector — enemy evasion against weapons with this injector is reduced by 100. Using cloaking, the enemy still has a small chance to evade.

СОВЕТ: Смерть — Помните, поражение — это.machine: Tip: Death - Remember, defeat is also part of the fun! ... No, seriously ...

СОВЕТ: Зачистка секторов — От каждого се.machine: Tip: stripping sectors - from each sector it is worth taking everything possible for the development of the ship, since each next sector is more complicated than the previous one.

СОВЕТ: Выходы — Мчаться к выходу из сект.machine: Tip: exits - rushing to the exit from the sector - tempting, but research is the only way to improve your ship.Try to squeeze everything out of each sector that is possible.

СОВЕТ: Цели — Задайте приоритет целей в.machine: Tip: goals - set the priority of goals in battle.Weapons and shields, as a rule, are the best choice, but when the enemy is going to run away, hit the engines or control control to prevent escape.

СОВЕТ: Скрытый выбор — Когда в событии в.machine: Tip: Hidden choice - when in the event you see an answer, illuminated by blue, this is a special option that has become available thanks to your equipment.But this choice is not always the best or safe.

СОВЕТ: Повреждение системы — Если из-за.machine: Tip: damage to the system-if, due to a fire or boarding, the system completely fails, then the case also receives a unit of damage.

СОВЕТ: Ячейки питания — Улучшенные систе.machine: Tip: power cells - improved systems can be useful, even if you do not have enough reactor energy to use them;They still absorb 1 damage.

СОВЕТ: Орудия — Вы можете поставить выст.machine: Tip: tools - you can put a shot in line before the gun is charged.It will shoot as soon as it charges.

СОВЕТ: Маскировка — Маскировка не только.machine: Tip: disguise - masking will not only allow you to avoid damage from enemy’s shots, but also stops charging his guns.It also increases your deviation by 60.

СОВЕТ: Абордаж — Если вас берут на аборд.machine: Tip: boarding - if you are taken on boarding, fight in the medical compartment.If nothing helps, depressurize the compartments of the ship.

СОВЕТ: Кислород — Если отсек корабля окр.machine: Tip: oxygen - if the compartment of the ship is painted red, this means that you lose oxygen.The crew will receive damage, and the fire will stop burning in compartments with a red level of oxygen.

СОВЕТ: Пробивание щита — Ракеты игнориру.machine: Tip: breaking the shield - missiles ignore the shield.Use missiles to damage the shields on powerful ships.Just remember that protective drones can shoot down missiles!

СОВЕТ: Выбор — Каждый ваш выбор имеет не.machine: Tip: choice - each of your choice has several options for consequences.You can never be sure that it can happen.

СОВЕТ: Авто-огонь — Автоматическое веден.machine: Tip: Auto-Fire-Automatic Fire will allow you to continuously fire for once specified by you.But pay attention to what you fire from.If weapons use rockets, then follow their number.

СОВЕТ: Уклонение — Уклонение от выстрело.machine: Tip: evasion - evasion of enemy’s shots - this is important, but requires functioning engines and control cutting.The use of someone from the crew on the engines also increases evasion.

СОВЕТ: Сенсоры — Если корабль погрузится.machine: Tip: sensors - if the ship plunges into darkness, do not panic.Just repair the sensors subsystem.

СОВЕТ: Дроны — Если вас атакуют вражески.machine: Tip: Drones - if you are attacking enemy drones, then you kiss their drones system to temporarily turn them off.

СОВЕТ: Лучи — Лучевое оружие наносит уро.machine: Tip: Rays - radiation weapons are caused by damage based on the number of compartments that it struck.Each shield level blocks 1 unit of damage.Therefore, it is best to use radiation weapons when the enemy’s shield is disabled.

СОВЕТ: Огонь — Если огонь распространяет.machine: Tip: Fire - if the fire spreads, you can open the gateways and doors to release oxygen from the parts of your ship.Without oxygen, the fire will quickly go out.

СОВЕТ: Здоровье — Следите за здоровьем э.machine: Tip: Health - Follow the health of the crew!Use a honeycock to restore it.

СОВЕТ: Улучшение — Не забывайте улучшать.machine: Tip: Improvement - do not forget to improve your ship!Most often, the shields are priority, but do not underestimate the usefulness of subsystems.

Совет: Топливо — Каждый прыжок расходует.machine: Tip: Fuel - each jump consumes one unit of fuel, so follow your reserves.Buy fuel in stores so as not to be in a difficult position.

СОВЕТ: Звук — Отрегулировать громкость з.machine: Tip: Sound - adjust the volume of sounds and music in the settings menu.

СОВЕТ: Астероиды — Сражаться в поле асте.machine: Tip: Asteroids - to fight in the asteroid field is dangerous, but use it in your favor.Bow the enemy shields and let the stones make the rest for you.

СОВЕТ: Туманности — Попадание в туманнос.machine: Tip: Number - entering the nebula will temporarily slow down the advance of the rebel fleet, but they also have their own unique dangers.

СОВЕТ: Солнечные вспышки — Солнечные всп.machine: Tip: Solar outbreaks - solar outbreaks damage the case and set fire to.Make sure your shields are turned on to reduce this effect.

СОВЕТ: Счёт — Ваш счёт основывается на т.machine: Tip: The score - your account is based on how many ships you won, the number of explored beacons and a total collected scrap.

СОВЕТ: Усиления — Ваш корабль может имет.machine: Tip: APPLISE - your ship can only have 3 strengthening.They provide unique advantages for systems, crew or the entire ship.

СОВЕТ: Пробоины — Если в отсеке с пробои.machine: Tip: holes - if there is no oxygen in the breakdown compartment, try to open all the surrounding doors, this will make it less dangerous.

СОВЕТ: Флот повстанцев — Флот повстанцев.machine: Tip: the fleet of the rebels - the fleet of the rebels (displayed by a red circle on the map) is approaching closer to your position every time you make a jump.Some events can slow down or increase its speed.

СОВЕТ: Ионное оружие — Ионное оружие раз.machine: Tip: ion weapons - ion weapons discharge and blocks the systems for a while.If it falls into the shield, the system of shields itself receives ionization.

СОВЕТ: Подсистема шлюзов — Модернизация.machine: Tip: Substruction Substruction - modernization of your doors will significantly reduce the likelihood of a fire between the rooms and will significantly slow down the movements of enemies.

СОВЕТ: Диалоги с экипажем — Если сектор,.machine: Tip: Dialogs with a crew - if the sector in which you are in is a family for a crew member, then the dialogue with him in an empty lighthouse has more chances for success.For people, relatives are civil sectors and rebel sectors.

СОВЕТ: Магазины — Число маяков с магазин.machine: Tip: shops - the number of lighthouses with shops in the sector depends on its color.In the green sectors there are 2-3 stores, in red-1-2, in purple 1-3.There are no stores in the first sector.

СОВЕТ: Торговый сектор — В торговом сект.machine: Tip: The trading sector - there are 5 stores in the trading sector, and the number of dangerous lighthouses is less than in other sectors.There are also rumors about illegal equipment sold there.

СОВЕТ: Прототипы — Прототипы являются са.machine: Tip: Prototypes - prototypes are the most powerful tools that can only be obtained, but they often need support for other tools.To find prototypes, visit your own racial sectors.

СОВЕТ: Родной мир кристалинов — Родной м.machine: Tip: The Home World of Crystalins - the native world of crystalins can be found in 6 or 7 sector on the map of sectors.It contains only the rarest types of guns, as well as unique guns and crystaline drones.

СОВЕТ: Корабли ИИ — Корабли аватаров осн.machine: Tip: AI ships - Avatars ships are equipped with protection from ion weapons and unique prismatic lasers that cause ordinary and ion damage at the same time.

СОВЕТ: Особые возможности усилений — На.machine: Tip: Special capabilities of strengthening-on the starting beacons of 2-7 sectors, you can apply special opportunities for the strengthening of the ship.Their use will not always be successful or safe.

СОВЕТ: Древнее оружие ланиусов — У ланиу.machine: Tip: Ancient weapons of Lanius - Laniuses have survived information about the old photon weapons.Although it does not differ in high accuracy, it still poses a great threat.

СОВЕТ: Секторы Ордена — Пролёт сквозь се.machine: Tip: sectors of the order - flying through the sectors of the order can lead to burning your ship.Make sure that you have a fire extinguishing system.

СОВЕТ: Корабли Ордена — Корабли Ордена о.machine: Tip: Ships of the Order - Ships of the Order are equipped with incendiary weapons and fire extinguishing systems.Some classes also have improved engines.

СОВЕТ: Нестабильные секторы — Нестабильн.machine: Tip: unstable sectors - unstable sectors are known as one of the most dangerous sectors in the galaxy.Here they found the refuge of groups of hackers and pirates.

СОВЕТ: Элитные авторазведчики — Элитные.machine: Tip: elite auto intelligence - elite auto intelligence agents are more dangerous than usual, and are found only in the sectors of the rebels.They can repair holes, and their systems have an increased level of pumping.You can get a random weapon for the victory over them.

СОВЕТ: Корабли HAL — Беспилотники HAL не.machine: Tip: HAL ships - HAL drones do not have a gun system, but equipped with ion phase artillery that damages the crew.Their combat drones are protected using the interference generator.

СОВЕТ: Дроны HAL — Дроны HAL являются са.machine: Tip: HAL drones - Hal drones are the fastest and most destructive in the galaxy.A separate mention is a repairman of HAL systems, capable of working even with a destroyed drone system.

СОВЕТ: ОЗУ — Одноразовые залповые устано.machine: Tip: RAM - disposable volleys are found in purple sectors.They do not require energy, but shoot only once in battle.

СОВЕТ: Пограничный сектор — В погранично.machine: Tip: The border sector - representatives of all races are found in the border sector.It is here that the main line of the front of the war with the rebels takes place.

СОВЕТ: Система дронов — Приобретя систем.machine: Tip: Drones system - by purchasing a drone system in a store, you will receive as a gift to a random drone of one of the three categories - attacking, protective or auxiliary.

СОВЕТ: Чёрное крыло — Крейсеры чёрного к.machine: Tip: The Black Wing - the cruisers of the black wing are advanced cruisers of the rebels, they are equipped with an indestructible tool system and pursue your ship without covering the PKB.For their destruction, you can get a good reward.

СОВЕТ: Ремонтные станции инжи — В сектор.machine: Tip: In engine repair stations - in the Sectors of the engineering, repair stations can be located with a 50% probability.In the native world, there is always a repair station.The stations provide repair services and supply supplies for a small fee.

СОВЕТ: Флагман повстанцев — Чем выше сло.machine: Tip: The flagship of the rebels - the higher the complexity, the stronger the artillery of the flagship.With the growth of complexity, ion artillery reloads faster, rockets and laser more often cause fires and holes, and the beam becomes longer.The strength of the flagship body and its coloring also depend on complexity.

СОВЕТ: Ремонт — Стоимость ремонта корабл.machine: Tip: Repair - the cost of repairing the ship in the store depends on the number of the sector.From 1 to 3 sector is 2 ~.From 4 to 6 sector - 3 ~.Repair in 7 and 8 sector costs 4 ~.

СОВЕТ: Авто-корабли — На некоторых беспи.machine: Tip: Auto-Cracles-reinforcements are additionally installed on some drones.Auto-hackers use a paralyzing module, auto-aggressors-a car recovery, auto-destructors-two auto-resident.

12.text: TIP: Injectors — Injector augments can improve your weapon parameters. Keep in mind that their application is single-use; you cannot upgrade an already upgraded weapon or a weapon that is not compatible with that specific injector.

СОВЕТ: Золтонские лучи — Золтонские лучи.machine: Tip: Zolton rays - Zolton rays one and a half times longer than usual and have increased chances to cause a fire or hole.For their work, it is necessary to have at least 30 missiles in the hold, but they are not spent with each ray shot.Rays on hostile ships can work without missiles.

СОВЕТ: Золтонские ионные орудия — Золтон.machine: Tip: Zolton ion guns - Zolton ion guns combine the properties of heavy and impulse ion guns.

СОВЕТ: UWB-пушки — UWB-пушки используют.machine: Tip: UWB guns-UWB guns use smuggles to hide their guns that are inside these universal shells.There are no bombs inside the UWB.UWB also accelerates the reloading of the weapon inside by 10%.

СОВЕТ: Золтонские корабли — В отличии от.machine: Tip: Zolton ships - unlike the Zoltans, the Zolton people do not have a protective superchit.Instead, their usual shields are invulnerable to direct damage, but fires and heavy ion guns can still damage them.Zolton ships are equipped with a weak reactor and a reserve battery.

СОВЕТ: Золтонские беспилотники — Как и п.machine: Tip: Zolton drones - like the piloted ships of the Zoltons, the Zolton drones have invulnerable shields, a weak reactor and a reserve battery.They guard the nebula of the Zolton sectors.

СОВЕТ: Артиллерии — Вы можете приобрести.machine: Tip: Artillery - You can purchase an artillery system in a store.Its type will depend on the class of the ship on which you are flying.Acquired artillery will be immediately 2nd level.

СОВЕТ: Универсальный инжектор — его бону.machine:
Tip: a universal injector - its bonus depends on the type of weapon to which the injector is applied:
	Lasers, ionki: +50% to the speed of shells, +15 damage to the crew.
	Rockets, mines, weapons of crystalins, twist: +1 basic damage.
	Bombs, effectors: +1 bomb per shot.
	Weapons with a scatter: -30% of the radius of the scatter of shells.
	Long rays: +25% to the length and to the speed of the beam.
	Point rays: +1 Damage by systems.

СОВЕТ: Легендарное оружие — Легендарные.machine: Tip: legendary weapons - legendary tools are very rare, they are found only in unique, "domestic" sectors (except for the trade, border and the monastery of the tears).These guns are incredibly powerful.

СОВЕТ: Пауза — Для постановки игры на па.machine: Tip: Pause - to set the game pause, click the gap.During a pause, you can give orders and control the ship systems.

СОВЕТ: Торговля — Оружие, дроны и усилен.machine: Tip: trade - weapons, drones and amplifiers can be sold at 1/2 from the price in the store.Click on top to sell.

СОВЕТ: Горячие клавиши — Вы можете запит.machine: Tip: Hot keys-you can power or choose weapons using the numbers: 1-4 on the keyboard-weapon slots, 5-7-drones (changes in the settings).

СОВЕТ: Размер шрифта — Нажатие + / - (из.machine: Tip: font size - pressing + / - (changes in the settings) will allow you to change the size of the text of the events.

СОВЕТ: Порядок оружия — Переставьте оруж.machine: Tip: Weapon order - rearrange the weapon or drone scheme, simply dragging it to the desired position.The left slot will turn off last, if the system is damaged.

СОВЕТ: Пауза — Нажмите кнопку PAUSE в лю.machine: Tip: pause - click the PAUSE button at any time to stop the game.You can give orders to the crew or control the power supply during a pause.

СОВЕТ: Торговля — Оружие, дронов и усиле.machine: Tip: Trade - weapons, drones and strengthening can be sold at half price in the store.Click the tab to sell at the top.

СОВЕТ: Порядок орудий — перестраивайте о.machine: Tip: The order of guns - rebuild the guns or drones by moving them to the desired position.The very first slot will be turned off the last if the system is damaged.

Это прототип корабля, который использует.machine: This is a prototype of the ship that uses advanced masking technology.The disadvantage is the absence of shields or weapons.Use the ability to disguise so that enemy shots do not get on you.

Этот корабль основан на конструкции, кот.machine: This ship is based on a design that existed before the technology of shielding and was a standard for all ships.The armored body and increased mobility are its main advantage.

Этот корабль Федерации предназначен для.machine: This ship of the Federation is designed to test the new advanced technology of reloading shields.Unfortunately, you were forced to test him alone.

Этот корабль был предназначен для перебр.machine: This ship was intended to transfer troops to the rear of the enemy.As such, he is not equipped with default guns, but his crew is the best of the best.

Этот корабль представляет собой модифици.machine: This ship is a modified mining ship that contains advanced AI to control drones.He is not entirely ready for battle, but let's hope that the drones will cover his shortcomings.

Ваше новое судно оснащено современными р.machine: Your new ship is equipped with modern robots and radiation weapons.It was difficult to find a full crew, since it was quite scary to work with robots

Инженер который спроектировал этот кораб.machine: An engineer who designed this ship clearly loved missiles.Only a few opponents will be able to withstand the barrage missiles of this vessel, but be sure that you have checked your ammunition reserves

Поздравляем с окончанием обучения! В кач.machine: Congratulations on the end of training!As the last lesson, you will experience what it is like to be destroyed by a stronger enemy.This pirate ship is equipped with the most advanced weapons and systems, including the prototype of the disguise.He was going to aliens known as the best engineers of the galaxy.And we also turned off your engines, so it makes no sense to try to run away.

Невозможно! Он должен был быть непобедим.machine: Impossible!He had to be invincible!Even the creators of the simulation did not work out.Continue, you deserve it.

Мы попали в поле астероидов! Придётся жд.machine: We got into the asteroid field!We will have to wait for the charge of the FTL drive before we can get out of here.Let's hope that the ship will withstand.

Ваш корабль пока что не оборудован систе.machine: Your ship has not yet been equipped with a drone system.You have processed the drone scheme for scrap.

Вы наткнулись на скрытую исследовательск.machine: You came across a hidden research laboratory of the Federation!They experimented with some unique ships projects.You downloaded schemes and drawings for use in the future.

12.text: Just talk to the crew before the FTL drive charges.
It seems that one of your crew members is now perfectly trained in all skills. This should come in handy...

Вы нашли космическую станцию, установлен.machine: You have found a space station installed for travelers.Looking through the lists, you find a tavern full of mercenaries.You are looking for potential crew members.

Кажется, этот маяк служит местом встречи.machine: This lighthouse seems to serve as a meeting place for local.It seems that here you can find a crew ready to fight on your ship ... for a certain price.

В этом нет нужды, наш реактор уже максим.machine: There is no need for this, our reactor is already the maximum level.

«Вы выглядите как военное судно. Мы пыта.machine: “You look like a military ship.We are trying to return home alive.I am an engineer, and I could try to improve your reactor if you have additional reserves. ”

Вы произвели обмен, и их команда заходит.machine: You exchange, and their team enters the board to improve your reactor.

Вы благодарите их за их предложение, но.machine: You thank them for their proposal, but get ready to move on.
